source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Your army gains and spends YP:

- As your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) ends, gain 1YP per controlled objective marker outside your deployment zone with 1 or more of your **IRON-MASTER** or **MEMNYR STRATEGIST** models in range (at most 2YP per turn from this rule).
- In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), when you select a **BRÔKHYR**, **IRONKIN STEELJACKS** or **ARKANYST EVALUATOR** unit of yours to shoot, you may spend 1YP; until the phase ends, that unit's models re-roll [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) of 1.
